title: Video shell conversation and panel host page
summary: The primary Video workspace shell at /video/shell/: owns the left project/session sidebar, the central conversation thread and composer, session activation scopes and history snapshots, and embeds the classic editor at /video/?mode=panel&session=<id> as a read-only editing panel.

carrier.notes: Served under /video/shell/ from static/v3/shell/ (or the Official lumeri.workspace frontend bundle); /video/ redirects to /video/shell/ unless ?ui=classic or ?mode= is present.

replaceability.why: The shell owns the account gate, session activation scopes, history snapshot writes, turn submission/steering/stopping, ask-card submission, and the iframe boundary around the editing panel.
replaceability.decided: self-Luc spec v0.3 foundation (the editor page shell); docs/luc/self-luc-inventory.md:100

reach.notes: Talks to the Gateway with the creator's session cookie via window.LumeriApi.

operations.name: activate

output.description: Activated session payload when the activation scope is still current, or null when superseded.

operations.notes: Restores saved history before opening the EventSource stream and points #panel-frame at /video/?mode=panel&session=<session_id>.

operations.name: submitTurn

output.description: True when POST /sessions/{id}/turn starts or binds the turn; false when superseded or refused.

operations.notes: Persists the user message to /session-history before POST /sessions/{id}/turn and retries once on E_REVISION_CONFLICT after syncing the session revision.

operations.name: LumeriShellTurns.apply
operations.notes: Pure conversation reducer: routes each SSE event to its turn, strips <activity>/<report> markup, filters unsafe activity labels, and passes PANEL_KINDS quietly.

invariants.text: The embedded /video/?mode=panel&session=<id> page observes the session and never writes session history, titles, or the current-session pointer.
Saved history is hydrated into the conversation model before the session EventSource stream is opened.
Activity labels matching code, paths, secrets, or internal identifiers are dropped, <activity>/<report> markup is stripped from replies, and panel event kinds pass without unknown-event notices.

break: The account gate cannot reach the backend or establish the account boundary.
A turn submission or history save encounters a revision conflict or HTTP failure.
The embedded panel frame is blocked or unavailable.
failure.notes: Shows the account gate error, stops overwriting newer history on E_SNAPSHOT_REVISION, marks the turn failed on conflict/error, or hides the panel frame with a notice.
